newsitem.title: MONGOLIA: Mongolia trade surplus $28.3 mln in Jan-May.
newsitem.headline: Mongolia trade surplus $28.3 mln in Jan-May.

text.p: Mongolia registered a $28.3 million trade surplus in January-May compared with a $6.8 million deficit a year ago, the State Statistical Bulletin said in an edition available on Wednesday.

Exports in the first five months of this year were $154.6 million compared with $166.7 million in the year-ago period. Imports were $126.3 million against $173.5 million a year earlier, the bulletin said.
In May alone, exports were $39.3 million, up from $32.8 million a year ago, while imports fell to $18.7 million from $46.5 million last year.
Of the exports in the first five months, $89.48 million came from mineral products, and $36.05 million from garments. Mongolia's main export item is copper concentrate.
Imports of machinery, equipment and electric appliances reached $39.47 million in the five-month period while mineral and petroleum products stood at $22.20 million.
